turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Explain that.
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
I'm not here about parking, Hale. The zero.
Love the coat, by the way.
Don't. What do you have on his essay?
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.
Chill. My son has a zero in the gradebook, and you haven't said why.
